preconditions.description: The number of cities is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of roads is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of queries is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The building type and crowd value for each city and road are between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.
The starting city, destination city, and minimum number of unique buildings for each query are between 1 and n, inclusive.
No road starts and ends in the same city.

postconditions.expression: For each query, print the minimum crowd value for a path between x_j and y_j that has at least k_j different buildings along the route
postconditions.description: If there is no such path, print -1.
